title: Factory move C: the read path — status, supervisor, dashboard, cloud commands
description:
The read half of the factory move.

Move: status.go, supervisor.go and dashboard/ (a read-only TUI over runs, phases, gates and refusals).

Wire 'ticfac factory status', 'ticfac factory dashboard', and the cloud commands 'ticfac cloud run|stop|status|logs|trace|supervisor'. Those use only a thin slice of the factory package — LoadCredentials, ReadSupervisor, the Supervisor types, SecretGatewayBaseURL and RunWorkflowName.

The dashboard imports gatewaytrace, which ek7 moves.

It reads deploy.go's public types, so land it after or alongside the deploy tick rather than before.

Do NOT delete anything from the ticks repo here.
acceptance_criteria: ticfac factory status and dashboard and the six cloud subcommands work from the ticfac CLI; the dashboard renders against a real run; no ticks Go package is imported; ticks is untouched by this tick; go test -short -timeout 45m ./... green (make test-short).
